import json, pathlib
m = json.load(open('.cursor/skills/skills-manifest.v2.json'))
root = pathlib.Path(m['skillsRoot'])
missing = []
for s in m.get('portableSkills', []) + m.get('skills', []):
    e = s.get('entry')
    if e and not (root / e).exists():
        missing.append(('entry', e))
    refdir = s.get('referencesDir')
    for k in (s.get('refKeywords') or {}):
        p = (root / refdir / k) if refdir else (root / k)
        if not p.exists():
            missing.append(('ref', str(p)))
print('MISSING', missing)
raise SystemExit(1 if missing else 0)
